name: Iemoto
source:
Main character inherits a mystery flower arrangement facility that originated 600 years ago. The art of making flower bowls is nurtured there, but women take the place of vases... In a month's time his father is going to die, and main character is expected to express himself well with the new art.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公继承了一个起源于600年前的神秘花道流派。那里传承着制作“花器”的技艺，充当花瓶的却是女人……父亲将在一个月后离世，而主人公必须用这门崭新的艺术，充分展现自己的造诣。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
